@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.cofacial_star_embedding : ∀
  {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph),
  (∀ (F : P.Face), (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 3 ∨ (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 4) →
    ∀ (a : ↑(frontier P.body)) (source : Fin 6),
      ↑a = ↑(graph.vertex source) →
        (∀ (v : ↑P.Vertex), ∃ F, ↑a ∈ ↑F ∧ ↑v ∈ ↑F) →
          ∃ develop,
            Topology.IsOpenEmbedding ⇑develop ∧
              Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range ⇑develop) ∧
                IsPathConnected (Set.range ⇑develop) ∧
                  (∃ edges, frontier (Set.range ⇑develop) = ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) ∧
                    ∀ (b : P.UncutSurface a),
                      ∃ radius > 0,
                        ∀ (c d : P.UncutSurface a),
                          dist ↑↑c ↑↑b < radius →
                            dist ↑↑d ↑↑b < radius → dist (develop c) (develop d) = P.surfaceDist ↑↑c ↑↑d

  Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane → Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane → Type
SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.finite_chain_endpoint_separation : ∀ (n : ℕ) (regions kites : ℕ → Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane)
  (steps : (i : Fin n) → SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.RegionStep (regions ↑i) (regions (↑i + 1)) (kites ↑i))
  (first last : Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane),
  first ⊆ regions 0 →
    Disjoint (regions n) (interior last) →
      ∃ frames,
        frames 0 = AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ SixVertexUnfolding.Plane ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin n) (x : SixVertexUnfolding.Plane), (frames (↑i + 1)) ((steps i).motion x) = (frames ↑i) x) ∧
            Disjoint first (interior (⇑(frames n) '' last))
'SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.finite_chain_endpoint_separation' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.finite_chain_separation : ∀ (n : ℕ) (regions kites : ℕ → Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane)
  (steps : (i : Fin n) → SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.RegionStep (regions ↑i) (regions (↑i + 1)) (kites ↑i)),
  ∃ frames,
    frames 0 = AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ SixVertexUnfolding.Plane ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin n) (x : SixVertexUnfolding.Plane), (frames (↑i + 1)) ((steps i).motion x) = (frames ↑i) x) ∧
        (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < n → Disjoint (⇑(frames i) '' kites i) (interior (⇑(frames j) '' kites j))) ∧
          (∀ j < n, Disjoint (regions 0) (interior (⇑(frames j) '' kites j))) ∧
            ∀ (i j : ℕ), i ≤ j → j ≤ n → ⇑(frames i) '' regions i ⊆ ⇑(frames j) '' regions j
'SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.finite_chain_separation' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gapKite : SixVertexUnfolding.Plane → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Set SixVertexUnfolding.Plane
SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gap_rotate_and_move_with_sources : ∀ (z : SixVertexUnfolding.Plane) {d L α β γ δ ω : ℝ},
  0 < d →
    0 < L →
      γ < δ →
        δ < γ + 2 * Real.pi →
          β ≤ γ ∧ δ ≤ α + 2 * Real.pi ∨ δ ≤ α ∧ β ≤ γ + 2 * Real.pi →
            Real.pi / 2 ≤ ω →
              ω +
                    EuclideanGeometry.angle z (z + d • SixVertexUnfolding.direction δ)
                      (z + L • SixVertexUnfolding.direction ((γ + δ) / 2)) ≤
                  3 * Real.pi / 2 →
                have y := z + L • SixVertexUnfolding.direction ((γ + δ) / 2);
                have apex := EuclideanGeometry.angle z (z + d • SixVertexUnfolding.direction δ) y;
                have W := {x | x - z ∈ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d ω α β};
                have V := {x | x - z ∈ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * Real.pi)};
                ∃ D Θ,
                  0 < D ∧
                    0 < Θ ∧
                      Θ < Real.pi ∧
                        z + d • SixVertexUnfolding.direction δ =
                            y + D • SixVertexUnfolding.direction (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) ∧
                          z + d • SixVertexUnfolding.direction γ =
                              y + D • SixVertexUnfolding.direction (2 * Real.pi - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2) ∧
                            have W' :=
                              {x |
                                x - y ∈
                                  SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion D (ω + apex) (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)
                                    (2 * Real.pi - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)};
                            W ⊆ V ∧
                              Disjoint V (interior (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧
                                W' = V ∪ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gapKite z d L γ δ
'SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gap_rotate_and_move_with_sources' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan.wedge_step_with_parameters : ∀
  {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron} {a : ↑(frontier P.body)} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} {u : ↑T.vertices}
  (fan : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan T u)
  (incoming outgoing : ↑(SixVertexUnfolding.circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last)),
  incoming ≠ outgoing →
    ∀ (ω : ℝ),
      Real.pi / 2 ≤ ω →
        ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2 →
          have z := fan.order.chart.origin;
          have d := P.surfaceDist ↑a ↑(T.vertexTarget u);
          have L := dist ↑u ↑↑(fan.order.neighbors outgoing);
          have y := z + L • SixVertexUnfolding.direction ↑outgoing;
          ∃ α β γ δ,
            SixVertexUnfolding.IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last α β ∧
              SixVertexUnfolding.IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last γ δ ∧
                ↑incoming = (α + β) / 2 ∧
                  ↑outgoing = (γ + δ) / 2 ∧
                    ∃ D Θ,
                      0 < D ∧
                        0 < Θ ∧
                          Θ < Real.pi ∧
                            D = P.surfaceDist ↑a ↑(T.vertexTarget ↑(fan.order.neighbors outgoing)) ∧
                              Real.pi - Θ =
                                  EuclideanGeometry.angle (fan.triangles outgoing).model.first
                                    (fan.triangles outgoing).model.right (fan.triangles outgoing).model.left ∧
                                have W := {x | x - z ∈ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d ω α β};
                                have V := {x | x - z ∈ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d ω δ (γ + 2 * Real.pi)};
                                have W' :=
                                  {x |
                                    x - y ∈
                                      SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion D
                                        (ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle) (Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)
                                        (2 * Real.pi - Θ + (γ + δ) / 2)};
                                W ⊆ V ∧
                                  Disjoint V (interior (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gapKite z d L γ δ)) ∧
                                    W' = V ∪ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.gapKite z d L γ δ

@SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.left_remainder_identity : ∀ {kv kw K ka kb η lam ν ρ ξ ζ : ℝ},
  η + lam + ν + ρ = 2 * Real.pi - kv →
    ξ + ζ = Real.pi - η →
      kv + kw + K + ka + kb = 4 * Real.pi →
        2 * Real.pi + K - 2 * lam - ν =
          kv - kw + (SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.linkSlack ka ξ + SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.linkSlack kb ζ) +
              ν +
            2 * ρ
'SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.left_remainder_identity' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.wider_caseA_bounds : ∀ {kv kw K ka kb η lam ν ρ ξ ζ : ℝ},
  η + lam + ν + ρ = 2 * Real.pi - kv →
    ξ + ζ = Real.pi - η →
      kv + kw + K + ka + kb = 4 * Real.pi →
        kw ≤ kv →
          0 < lam →
            0 < ν →
              0 < ρ →
                0 < SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.linkSlack ka ξ →
                  0 < SixVertexUnfolding.PairedPoles.linkSlack kb ζ →
                    lam < (Real.pi + (Real.pi - ν + K)) / 2 ∧ ρ < (Real.pi + (Real.pi - ν + K)) / 2

@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.small_shortest_routes_agree_of_meeting : ∀
  {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron},
  P.vertices.card ≤ 6 →
    (∀ (F : P.Face), (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 3 ∨ (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 4) →
      ∀ {a b : SixVertexUnfolding.Space} (first second : P.SurfacePath a b),
        a ≠ b →
          first.IsShortest →
            second.IsShortest →
              first.length ≠ ⊤ →
                second.length ≠ ⊤ →
                  LipschitzWith first.length.toNNReal ⇑first.curve →
                    LipschitzWith second.length.toNNReal ⇑second.curve →
                      ∀ (m : ↑unitInterval),
                        0 < m →
                          m < 1 → first.curve m = second.curve m → ∀ (t : ↑unitInterval), first.curve t = second.curve t

@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_consistent_subdivision : ∀
  {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
  {small_faces : ∀ (F : P.Face), (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 3 ∨ (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6}
  {slit : Fin 4} (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit),
  graph.curvature (SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles.opposite source) ≤ graph.curvature source →
    (∀ (i : Fin 4),
        graph.curvature (SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles.fanNeighbor source i) ≤
          graph.curvature (SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralTriangles.fanNeighbor source slit)) →
      (∀ (x y : SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralNet.FaceIndex),
          graph.netFace small_faces source slit x = graph.netFace small_faces source slit y →
            Set.EqOn ⇑(net.place x) ⇑(net.place y) ↑(graph.netFace small_faces source slit y)) →
        P.HasEdgeUnfolding

 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.universal_star_embedding : ∀ {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron},
  P.vertices.card = 6 →
    (∀ (F : P.Face), (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 3 ∨ (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 4) →
      ∀ (a : ↑(frontier P.body)) (source : ↑P.Vertex),
        ↑a = ↑source →
          (∀ (v : ↑P.Vertex), v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) →
            ∃ develop,
              Topology.IsOpenEmbedding ⇑develop ∧
                Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range ⇑develop) ∧
                  IsPathConnected (Set.range ⇑develop) ∧
                    (∃ edges, frontier (Set.range ⇑develop) = ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) ∧
                      ∀ (b : P.UncutSurface a),
                        ∃ radius > 0,
                          ∀ (c d : P.UncutSurface a),
                            dist ↑↑c ↑↑b < radius →
                              dist ↑↑d ↑↑b < radius → dist (develop c) (develop d) = P.surfaceDist ↑↑c ↑↑d

@SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.universal_global_kites_nonoverlap : ∀ {P : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron},
  P.vertices.card = 6 →
    (∀ (F : P.Face), (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 3 ∨ (↑F ∩ ↑P.vertices).ncard = 4) →
      ∀ {a : ↑(frontier P.body)} (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (charts : SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutTreeCharts T)
        (source : ↑P.Vertex),
        (∀ (v : ↑P.Vertex), v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) →
          ↑a = ↑source →
            ∀ {u v w z : ↑T.vertices} (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (last : T.graph.Adj w z),
              s(u, v) ≠ s(w, z) → Disjoint (charts.kite first) (interior (charts.kite last))

@SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.ArmCoordinates.rotate_and_move : ∀ {h r a b d θ γ : ℝ},
  SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.ArmCoordinates h r a b d θ γ →
    ∀ {q D Θ lower upper : ℝ},
      r ≤ q →
        0 < D →
          0 < Θ →
            Θ < Real.pi →
              -q = D * Real.cos Θ →
                h = D * Real.sin Θ →
                  θ ≤ lower →
                    upper ≤ 2 * Real.pi - θ →
                      γ +
                            EuclideanGeometry.angle (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point r 0)
                              (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point 0 h) (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point q 0) ≤
                          3 * Real.pi / 2 →
                        have α :=
                          EuclideanGeometry.angle (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point r 0)
                            (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point 0 h) (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point q 0);
                        have W :=
                          {z |
                            z - SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point r 0 ∈
                              SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d γ lower upper};
                        have V :=
                          {z |
                            z - SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point r 0 ∈
                              SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion d γ θ (2 * Real.pi - θ)};
                        have W' :=
                          {z |
                            z - SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.point q 0 ∈
                              SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.polarRegion D (γ + α) Θ (2 * Real.pi - Θ)};
                        W ⊆ V ∧
                          Disjoint V (interior (SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.kite h r q)) ∧
                            W' = V ∪ SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.kite h r q
'SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge.ArmCoordinates.rotate_and_move' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
SixVertexUnfolding.wider_apex_cones : ∀ (p q : SixVertexUnfolding.Plane) (δ θ lam rho A B : ℝ),
  0 < θ →
    θ < Real.pi →
      0 < lam →
        lam < Real.pi →
          0 < rho →
            rho < Real.pi →
              lam + rho < Real.pi + θ →
                lam ≤ (Real.pi + θ) / 2 →
                  rho ≤ (Real.pi + θ) / 2 →
                    A + B < 0 →
                      q - p = A • SixVertexUnfolding.direction (δ + θ) + B • SixVertexUnfolding.direction δ →
                        Disjoint
                          (interior
                            (SixVertexUnfolding.translatedCone p (SixVertexUnfolding.direction (δ + θ - lam))
                              (SixVertexUnfolding.direction (δ + θ))))
                          (interior
                            (SixVertexUnfolding.translatedCone q (-SixVertexUnfolding.direction δ)
                              (-SixVertexUnfolding.direction (δ + rho))))
'SixVertexUnfolding.wider_apex_cones' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
